targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, LogAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS namespace, count() AS lines
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${namespace:singlequote})
  AND ('${search}' = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '${search}') > 0)
GROUP BY time, namespace
ORDER BY time

SELECT LogAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS namespace, LogAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, LogAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, count() AS lines
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${namespace:singlequote})
  AND ('${search}' = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '${search}') > 0)
GROUP BY namespace, pod, container
ORDER BY lines DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, Body AS body,
  LogAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS namespace,
  LogAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod,
  LogAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container,
  LogAttributes['log.iostream'] AS stream
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${namespace:singlequote})
  AND ('${search}' = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '${search}') > 0)
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1000
